rows.role_title: 幹部会委員長 — Executive Committee chair
rows.text: The party organ prints the summation given on the final day of the 26th Congress, the 18th, by 志位和夫委員長 ('日本共産党第２６回大会最終日の１８日、志位和夫委員長が行った、大会決議案と中央委員会報告についての討論の結語').

bounded_scope: Party-office observations of the 日本共産党 Executive Committee chair (幹部会委員長) and Central Committee chair (中央委員会議長) and of the 国民民主党 representative (代表), for CLAUDE-C01-42 only, 1990-2026. Congress and plenum elections, in-office attestations, withdrawals, honorary offices, rule procedure, suspensions, acting service, the earlier 国民民主党 of 2018-2020 and its offices, and organization events stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. A null holder_name means the row names no holder of this office (an organization event, procedure, another office, acting service or an election that names nobody). The prime-ministership (jp_pm), ministerial offices, parliamentary groups and other parties' offices are excluded; organization identities stay unresolved, and no row maps or merges the 国民民主党 of 2018-2020 with the 2025 election-list observation or any other organization.
